title: fix(plugin-grid,core): the selection bar asks the one declared-gate definition, so a whitespace or empty-source visible gate shows there as on rows and toolbars (objectui#11322)
body:
Fixes #11322
Clause-②: no

The grid's selection bar now asks the action family's one "is a gate declared?" definition, `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate`, before it decides anything about a bulk action. A bulk action whose `visible` is whitespace-only, or an envelope whose `source` is blank, now shows on the selection bar and runs over every selected record, as it already does on the row menu and the toolbars of the same grid. The built-in Delete is unchanged: a blank `userActions.delete.visibleWhen` still excludes every selected record on both bulk bars, as on `main`. Session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec` (`domain:ui` seat 2, branch `claude/issue-11322-bulk-bar-declared-gate`).

This body describes the diff at head `5661606d6`. The first revision (`88ed87044`) also moved core's `partitionRowsByPredicate` onto the declared-gate definition. Triage withdrew that half on the retriage question (`5926391467`, "Not A"): the partitioner is shared, and two of its callers pass the built-in Delete's `visibleWhen`, a field-rule key. `b889377c3` reverted it.

## What changed, against `main`

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/bulkEligibility.ts`
  - `hasVisibilityGate` returns `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate(def?.visible)`, imported from the `@object-ui/components` barrel, instead of `visible != null && visible !== ''`.
  - `partitionBulkRows` asks `hasVisibilityGate` before it calls the fold, and hands an undeclared gate over as `undefined`. The action family decides "declared?" here; core's fold never decides it for a bulk action.
- `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: the built-in bulk Delete hands `userActions.delete.visibleWhen` to core's `partitionRowsByPredicate` directly, as plugin-list's `ListView` already does. The options are the ones `partitionBulkRows` used to pass (`warnOnError` true, label `delete`), so its answer is `main`'s. **Why this file:** with core back at `main`'s opening, `partitionBulkRows` has to ask "declared?" first, or the button shows while the run refuses every record. If the built-in Delete had stayed on that door, a blank `visibleWhen` would admit every record, which is the destructive widening triage ruled out. The ablation legs below measure both halves.
- `packages/core/src/evaluator/listConditional.ts` and `declaredPredicate.ts`: **comments only**. The code is byte-identical to `main`.
  - `partitionRowsByPredicate`'s docblock now names its callers: the bulk-action fold through `partitionBulkRows`, and the built-in Delete's `visibleWhen` from `ObjectGrid` and from `ListView` `bulkDeleteEligibility`. It says the action family decides "declared?" before calling it. Its "absent" bullet used to say "blank string" and now says what the test is: `null`, `undefined` or `''`.
  - `hasDeclaredPredicate`'s docblock names the one new consumer, plugin-grid's `hasVisibilityGate`. It names the field-rule tests that stay outside the family (the built-in row item's `!= null` and the partitioner's own opening test). Per AGENTS.md commandment 9, it says that no test or gate re-derives that paragraph.
- `packages/types/src/objectql.ts`: the `BulkActionDef.visible` docblock only. It now says the selection bar reads an `ast`-only envelope as no gate.
- No new predicate and no second blank test. The row menu and toolbar paths are unchanged.

## Pins

Selection bar: the real `BulkActionBar` with one selected row, in `bulk-action-visible.test.tsx`.

| authored `visible` | before (main) | after |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `'   '` | hidden | **shown** |
| `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '   ' }` | hidden | **shown** |
| `{ dialect: 'cel', source: '' }` | hidden | **shown** |
| `''` (control) | shown | shown |
| no `visible` key (control) | shown | shown |
| `false` (control, a declared gate) | hidden | hidden |

- `bulkEligibility.test.ts`: `hasVisibilityGate` is false for the three blank shapes. `partitionBulkRows` passes every record through by reference for them, which is the run path's answer. `hasVisibilityGate` answers what `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate` answers over the whole shape list.
- `specExpressionWire-10946.test.tsx`: an `ast`-only bulk `visible` is no declared gate, and every record qualifies (restated, see below).
- Built-in Delete, through the real components: in `bulkDeleteVisibleWhen.test.tsx` (`ObjectGrid`) and `ListView.bulkDeleteVisibleWhen.test.tsx` (`ListView`'s non-grid bar), a whitespace or blank-envelope `visibleWhen` still excludes every selected record. The grid's dialog refuses, the list states the skipped count, and nothing is deleted. The existing no-gate cases in both files are the controls.

## Ablation legs, at `5661606d6`

Each mutation went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which requires the anchor to hit once and checks that the blob hash moved. Each restore was proven by blob hash == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`. Every leg ran the same 6 files with 69 tests: the four plugin-grid pin files, `ListView.bulkDeleteVisibleWhen.test.tsx` and `RowActionMenu.test.tsx`.

| leg | failed / passed | red rows |
|:--|:--|:--|
| none (baseline) | 0 / 69 | none |
| `hasVisibilityGate` restored to `!= null && !== ''` | 11 / 58 | the 3 blank rows on the real `BulkActionBar`, the 3 blank `hasVisibilityGate` rows, the 3 `partitionBulkRows` by-reference rows, the parity row, and the `ast`-only row |
| `partitionBulkRows` hands `def.visible` to the fold unasked | 4 / 65 | the 3 `partitionBulkRows` by-reference rows and the `ast`-only row; the bar rows stay green |
| `ObjectGrid`'s built-in Delete routed back through `partitionBulkRows` | 2 / 67 | the 2 grid rows for a blank built-in Delete `visibleWhen` (no skipped notice: the whole selection went through) |

- With core at `main`'s opening, the plugin-grid site alone decides the bar: restoring `hasVisibilityGate` alone turns the three bar rows red.
- The second leg is the run: without the door asking first, the button shows but the fold excludes every record.
- The third leg is the reason `ObjectGrid.tsx` is in this diff.
- In every leg these stay green: the controls (`''`, no key, `false`, no built-in gate) and `RowActionMenu.test.tsx`.

## Existing pins and pending changesets restated

- `specExpressionWire-10946.test.tsx`: "an `ast`-only envelope qualifies no record (fail closed), and the fault is warned" now reads "is no declared gate: every record qualifies, as on the row menu". The file's docblock is restated too. Triage accepted this as built.
- `BulkActionDef.visible` docblock in `@object-ui/types`: restated, as above.
- `RowActionMenu.test.tsx`: the comment "`hasVisibilityGate` excludes `''` for the selection bar" is restated.
- Still true, left as they are: `RowActionMenu.emptyGuard.test.tsx` "an empty-string `visible` is no gate at all, matching `hasVisibilityGate`", and the two components tests of the same wording.
- The pending `.changeset/10946-expression-wire-slots-by-reference.md` says the bulk def "qualifies no record", and that the plugin-grid file pins the `ast`-only fault "on both". Those sentences would publish false. Following the precedent of PR objectui#11335's note on the 8655 entry, it gets an append-only, dated note naming this change; its frontmatter and every existing sentence are byte-identical. `check-changeset-overwrite` reports it as case 2, an intentional correction, with the declaration unchanged.
- The bot's other 27 pending changesets were re-read against this diff (the paragraph the bot quotes, and `6505-…` and `8069-…` in full), and each stays true as is. They name `objectql.ts`, `ObjectGrid.tsx` or `declaredPredicate.ts` for subjects this diff does not move: the gantt, form, kanban, tree, gallery and alert-dialog keys, i18n keys, export options, sort, page size, relational meta, the bulk-dialog data source, the validator's delegation to `hasDeclaredPredicate`, and the field-rule blank report. Found by symbol rather than file name, `4420-bulk-delete-visiblewhen` and `row-predicate-phase2-record-only-5741` (read in full) and the matching sentences of `8730-…` and `9572-…` are also true as is.

## Changesets

- `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch: the bar shows, and runs, a blank-gated bulk action; an `ast`-only `visible` is no gate; the built-in Delete is unchanged.
- `@object-ui/core` patch, **docblock only, no behavior change**. `check-changeset-presence` needs one declaration in the change (an empty frontmatter counts). This entry is there because the docblock ships in core's `.d.ts`, the same treatment as the types entry.
- `@object-ui/types` patch: docblock only.

## Acceptance notes

- **(a) `hasDeclaredPredicate` answers an `ast`-only envelope "not declared" with no report**, while ADR-0137 D4 says a faulting gate predicate is "diagnosed, never a silent true". That holds on the row menu, the toolbars and now the selection bar alike, so it is a question for the definition, not for one surface. `carrier:` the PM seat. **Measured: authoring does admit an `ast`-only envelope through one door.**
  - `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 refuses it on `ActionSchema.visible`, `BulkActionDefSchema.visible` and `ObjectSchema` `userActions.delete.visibleWhen`.
  - objectui's own `safeValidateSchema` refuses it on an `action:button` `visible` and on a `list-view` `bulkActionDefs[].visible`.
  - objectui's own `safeValidateSchema` **accepts** it on an `object-grid` node's `bulkActionDefs[].visible`. `ObjectGridSchema`'s zod face does not mirror `bulkActionDefs` at all: it is ledgered as `KnownDrift` in `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`, and the same probe accepts `visible: 42` and `bulkActionDefs: 'nope'`.
  - objectstack `main`'s spec was not measured: the shared objectstack checkout has no built `dist`.
- **(b) The field-rule family.** For the built-in Delete with `visibleWhen: ''`, the bulk bars admit every record while the row item hides; that is already so on `main`. The spec refuses these shapes at authoring, so no producer reaches them. `carrier: none`.
- `action-member-visible-gate.test.tsx`'s docblock still describes `hasDeclaredVisibilityGate` as `!= null && !== ''`, which has been stale since objectui#3850. Separately, the "installed spec admits it" sentences in the `BulkActionDef.visible` docblock and in the `specExpressionWire-10946.test.tsx` docblock are stale: spec 17.5.0's `BulkActionDefSchema` refuses an `ast`-only `visible`. This PR touches neither, and nobody carries either.
- `Spec Main Shape Gate` was red on every PR head until objectui#11330's fix merged (`47e3ce008`); its diagnostics were outside this diff. It is green on head `5661606d6`.
- In-flight overlap: `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` is also edited by open PR objectui#11335, and was edited by PR objectui#11337 (merged as `db0beb2aa`). The hunks are disjoint: mine is the `BulkActionDef.visible` docblock. No open PR touches `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `bulkEligibility.ts`, `listConditional.ts`, `declaredPredicate.ts` or the built-in Delete tests.

## Gates, at head `5661606d6`

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src packages/core/src/evaluator packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.bulkDeleteVisibleWhen.test.tsx --reporter=verbose`: 198 files passed; 2153 tests passed, 27 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/ packages/types/`: 485 files passed, 2 skipped; 13175 tests passed, 2 skipped.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-list`: exit 0 each.
  - They ran after turbo built plugin-grid's dependency closure (13 tasks), which covers plugin-list's.
  - `--listFilesOnly` puts the changed test files in the test programs: plugin-grid 5, plugin-list 1.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 11 changed TS files: 0 errors. Per-file warning counts equal `main`'s for every file, so the diff adds none.
  - The population is `eslint.config.js`'s `**/*.{ts,tsx}`.
  - The config has no type-aware linting and no custom rule that reads the disk, so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file.
- `check-changeset-presence` ("11 source file(s) of 4 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 3 changeset(s)"), `check-control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `markdown-test-inputs --audit`: exit 0 each.
- `check-changeset-overwrite`: report-only, case 2 as above. The governed-queue guard answers NOT GOVERNED.
- Declared narrowing: the full `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` belong to CI. That includes plugin-list's, components' and app-shell's whole suites.
